get.summary: Underproduction alarms of all installations
get.description: Stored results of the last analyses, newest first, at most 100; light enough for the dashboard to poll every minute (ADR #222), the ML service is not called. severity: Low, Medium, High. ongoing: true or false. A customer gets only the alarms of its own installations.

get.summary: List application roles

post.summary: Register a customer account
post.description: Creates a user with the Customer role. Internal roles are assigned by an administrator.

post.summary: Log in with e-mail and password
post.description: Returns a JWT access token (15 min) and a single-use refresh token (7 days). Any failure (unknown e-mail, wrong password, locked out account) returns the same 401.

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for a new token pair
post.description: The refresh token is single-use: it is replaced by the returned one. Reusing an already exchanged token revokes the whole session (401), except for a repeated request within a few seconds (concurrent tabs), which gets another valid token. Unknown, expired and revoked tokens return 401.

post.summary: Log out (revoke the refresh token and its session)
post.description: Needs no access token, so it works after the access token expired. Returns 204 even for unknown or already revoked tokens. Already issued access tokens stay valid until they expire (max. 15 min).

post.summary: Request a password reset link by e-mail
post.description: Always returns 202, whether or not the e-mail belongs to an account. The link is valid for 1 hour.

post.summary: Set a new password with the token from the reset link
post.description: Unknown e-mail, wrong or expired token all return the same 400. A new password that violates the policy returns 400 on newPassword. On success all sessions (refresh tokens) are revoked.

post.description: Body: decision (Approve, RequestInfo, Reject) and note (required for RequestInfo and Reject). Available in every environment except Production unless ConnectionRequest:Simulator:Enabled says otherwise (then 404).

post.description: Same availability as the decision endpoint.

get.summary: Get a contract with its lines and totals

delete.summary: Take a panel out of the string

post.summary: Run the ML prediction and underproduction detection
post.description: Predicts production from the stored weather forecast, then evaluates the finished hours with the detection of ADR #194 and stores both results. Repeating the call overwrites the predictions of the same hours and updates the same alarms. An ongoing alarm creates a service ticket with origin AnomalyDetected, or an internal comment on an open ticket of the installation. 503 when the ML service is unavailable, 502 when it returns an unusable answer; the data stored earlier stays available.

get.summary: Underproduction alarms of an installation
get.description: Stored results of the last analyses, newest first, at most 100; the ML service is not called. A customer sees only its own installations (another one is 404).

get.summary: Production of an installation for a period
get.description: from/to: ISO 8601 with Z or an offset (encode + as %2B), or a date meaning local midnight in timeZone; the period is [from, to). granularity: fiveMinutes, hour (default), day, month. timeZone: IANA id for day and month buckets, default Europe/Bratislava. A reading belongs to the bucket of its window start (timestamp - intervalSec); energy comes from the totalWh counters, peak power is the highest sum of the inverters' AC power. Only buckets with data are returned; an empty period gives an empty list. A customer sees only its own installations (another one is 404). Limits: fiveMinutes 31 days, hour 366 days, day and month 3660 days.

parameters.name: TimeZone
parameters.description: IANA time zone for day and month buckets and date-only bounds; default Europe/Bratislava.

get.summary: Actual production compared with the prediction
get.description: from/to: ISO 8601 with Z or an offset (encode + as %2B), or a date meaning local midnight in timeZone; the period is [from, to). granularity: fiveMinutes, hour (default), day, month. timeZone: IANA id for day and month buckets, default Europe/Bratislava. A reading belongs to the bucket of its window start (timestamp - intervalSec); energy comes from the totalWh counters, peak power is the highest sum of the inverters' AC power. Only buckets with data are returned; an empty period gives an empty list. A customer sees only its own installations (another one is 404). Granularity hour, day or month (predictions are hourly). Pairs of actual and predicted energy per bucket, with predictions stored by the analysis of the installation (#376). Without a stored prediction predictedEnergyKwh, deviationKwh and ratio are null and predictionAvailable is false.

parameters.name: TimeZone
parameters.description: IANA time zone for day and month buckets and date-only bounds; default Europe/Bratislava.

get.summary: Export production as CSV
get.description: from/to: ISO 8601 with Z or an offset (encode + as %2B), or a date meaning local midnight in timeZone; the period is [from, to). granularity: fiveMinutes, hour (default), day, month. timeZone: IANA id for day and month buckets, default Europe/Bratislava. A reading belongs to the bucket of its window start (timestamp - intervalSec); energy comes from the totalWh counters, peak power is the highest sum of the inverters' AC power. Only buckets with data are returned; an empty period gives an empty list. A customer sees only its own installations (another one is 404). text/csv (UTF-8) with a header row, streamed. separator: semicolon (default, decimal comma for Slovak Excel), comma or tab (decimal point). Limits: fiveMinutes 366 days, other granularities 3660 days.

parameters.name: Separator
parameters.description: `semicolon` (default, decimal comma for Slovak Excel), `comma` or `tab` (decimal point).

parameters.name: TimeZone
parameters.description: IANA time zone for day and month buckets and date-only bounds; default Europe/Bratislava.

post.description: A customer can have several supply points. The EIC code must have a valid format and be unique (409 otherwise).

get.summary: Get API name, version and environment

post.summary: Ingest a batch of inverter measurements
post.description: Contract: ADR #185 (schemaVersion 1.0, 1 to 288 readings on the 5-minute UTC grid). The batch is atomic: any invalid reading gives 400 (keys like readings[3].timestamp) and nothing is stored. Idempotent by (deviceId, timestamp): already stored readings are ignored and counted in 'duplicates'. Authentication: installation API key in the X-Api-Key header (#96); missing, unknown or revoked key = 401, installationId different from the key's installation = 403. 404 for an unknown installation.

post.summary: Report a fault for an installation (state New)
post.description: A customer may report only for its own installation (origin CustomerReport, priority Medium); staff create Manual tickets and may set the priority. At most 5 attachments (JPEG, PNG or PDF, base64) of 5 MB.

get.summary: List tickets with combinable filters and paging
get.description: Filters: state, priority, origin, installationId. Paging: page (default 1), pageSize (default 20, max 100). sortBy = createdAt | updatedAt | priority, sortDir = asc | desc (default createdAt desc). A customer sees only its own tickets.

get.summary: Get a ticket with attachment metadata and allowed transitions

put.summary: Set the priority of a new ticket (New to Triaged)

post.description: Allowed: New→Triaged→RemoteDiagnosis→Resolved→Closed, Verified→Resolved. VisitScheduled, OnSite and Verified are set by visits (#36, #37) and give 409 here, as does any edge outside the automaton. The user and time of every transition are stored in the history.

get.summary: State change history, oldest first (read-only)
get.description: Customers do not see the internal notes of the transitions.

Download one attachment of a ticket

post.description: Start and estimated duration (15 to 720 minutes). 409 when no technician is assigned, the ticket is in another state or the technician has an overlapping Planned or InProgress visit.

get.summary: Visits of a ticket with the assigned technician

post.summary: The technician verifies that production is restored (OnSite to Verified)
post.description: Requires a written service protocol. A technician may verify only own tickets.

post.summary: Resolve and close the ticket (Verified or RemoteDiagnosis to Resolved to Closed)
post.description: A ticket with a visit needs its service protocol, otherwise 409.

post.summary: The customer confirms that the fault is fixed (closed ticket)
The customer reopens a closed ticket within 7 days (back to RemoteDiagnosis)

put.summary: Change the date of a planned visit with a reason

post.summary: The technician arrived (visit InProgress, ticket OnSite)

serialNumber.description: Serial number from the label; unique across all installations, case-insensitive.

AddDeviceRequest.description: Registers a panel or inverter on an installation.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code; defaults to "SK".

AddressDto.description: Postal address in requests and responses.

isPublic.description: True when the customer may read the comment; default false (internal note).

ApprovalResponse.description: Who approved the design, when, and which configuration version was approved.

AssignTechniciansRequest.description: Replaces the set of technicians (user ids with role Technician) assigned to an installation.

contentType.description: Media type of the file, for example `application/pdf`; validated, parameters are not allowed.

sizeBytes.description: File size in bytes; may be 0 when string? AttachmentRequest.ContentBase64 is sent (the server derives it).

contentBase64.description: Base64 content of the file; at most long ConnectionRequest.MaxAttachmentBytes before encoding.

AttachmentRequest.description:
Metadata of one attachment, optionally with the file content. When string? AttachmentRequest.ContentBase64 is empty, only
metadata is stored (legacy clients); when it is set, the decoded file can be downloaded from the API.

AttachmentResponse.description: Attachment metadata as returned by the API.

CalendarVisit.description: One visit in a technician's calendar with the address and the contact of the customer (story #126).

note.description: Internal note stored in the history; not shown to the customer.

CommissioningProtocolResponse.description: Commissioning data printed in the hand-over protocol.

commissionedOn.description: Day the plant was put into operation; must not be in the future.

acceptedBy.description: Person who took the plant over on the customer's side.

ConfigureDesignRequest.description: Proposed system: a panel type with a count and an inverter, both from the catalog.

Connection request with its attachments and deadline. `ProposalRemainingDays` (calendar days, negative when late) and
`ProposalOverdue` are set only while the request waits for the distributor (state `Submitted`).

Lifecycle of a connection request (ADR #217, BPMN #64, mapping #69). #85 produces `Draft`; #86 adds
`Submitted`, `InfoRequested`, `Rejected`, `ContractOffered` ("schválená"), `ContractSigned` and
`ContractSubmitted`; `Concluded` is the distributor's final act (#87).

ConnectionRequestType.description: Branch of the process derived from the rated AC power (ADR #217).

ContractStatus.description: Lifecycle of a contract (BPMN mapping #69). PDF and sending states follow with #80.

powerW.description: Rated power in watts; required for panels and inverters.

unitPrice.description: Price per unit in EUR (per hour for labor), at most two decimals.

installationId.description: Installation (module Installations) the request belongs to.

eicCode.description: EIC code of the supply point.

ratedAcPowerKw.description: Total rated AC power of the inverters in kW; above 10.8 kW the request is a large source.

mainBreakerAmps.description: Main breaker of the supply point in amperes per phase.

attachments.description: Must contain at least a `SingleLineDiagram` and an `OwnerConsent`.

CreateConnectionRequestRequest.description: Payload for creating a connection request (state `Draft`).

CreateContractRequest.description: Payload for `POST /api/contracts`: the contract is made from this accepted quote.

email.description: Contact e-mail; must be unique among customers.

userId.description: Optional login account (user with role Customer) linked to this customer.

supplyPointId.description: Supply point (odberné miesto) the design is bound to.

CreateFveDesignRequest.description: Starts a design for a customer's supply point.

customerId.description: Customer (module Customers) the installation is built for.

contractId.description: Signed contract (module Contracts); one installation per contract.

supplyPointId.description: Supply point (odberné miesto) where the plant is connected.

plannedPowerKwp.description: Planned DC power in kWp from the design (optional).

vatRatePercent.description: VAT rate in percent; defaults to 23.

number.description: String number as the inverter reports it in telemetry (`strings[].id`); unique within the installation.

mpptInput.description: MPPT input of the inverter the string is wired to.

eicCode.description: EIC code of the metering point (16 characters, e.g. "24ZSS1234567890A"); whitespace is ignored.

mainBreakerAmps.description: Rated current of the main circuit breaker in amperes (1-1000).

note.description: What is missing or why the request was refused; required for `RequestInfo` and `Reject`.

DocumentDownloadResponse.description: One recorded download of a document.

ForgotPasswordRequest.description: Request for a password reset link.

alarms.description: Number of alarms the detection reported in this run.

ongoingAlarms.description: How many of them are still ongoing.

actualEnergyKwh.description: Null when there is no measurement in the bucket (missing data is not zero production).

validUntil.description: Validity of the revision; required and after DateOnly? RecordRevisionReportRequest.InspectedOn for a passed revision.

findings.description: Defects found; required for a failed revision.

RecordRevisionReportRequest.description: Revision report with its file as base64 (#91). Allowed files: PDF, PNG, JPEG up to 5 MB.

password.description: Must satisfy the password policy (min. 10 characters, upper and lower case letter, digit).

reason.description: Why the device is replaced (fault, warranty claim, ...).

serialNumber.description: Serial number from the label; unique across all installations, case-insensitive.

ReplaceDeviceRequest.description: The device that takes the place of an installed one; it has the same type.

ReplaceVisitMaterialsRequest.description: Payload of `PUT /api/visits/{id}/materials`: replaces the whole list of used material (story #128).

newPassword.description: Must satisfy the password policy (min. 10 characters, upper and lower case letter, digit).

ResetPasswordRequest.description: Sets a new password with the token from the reset link.

RescheduleVisitRequest.description: Payload of `PUT /api/visits/{id}/schedule`: a new date with the reason of the change.

RevisionReportResponse.description: Revision report metadata; the file itself is downloaded separately.

RevisionResult.description: Outcome of the revision (odborná prehliadka a skúška) of a PV plant (#91).

ReworkDesignRequest.description: Reason why the design does not satisfy yet and goes back to the designer.

ReworkResponse.description: Last request to rework the design.

azimuthDeg.description: Azimuth in degrees, PVGIS convention: 0 = south, -90 = east, 90 = west, ±180 = north.

tiltDeg.description: Tilt from horizontal in degrees, 0 (flat) to 90 (vertical).

usableAreaM2.description: Area usable for panels in m².

shadingLossPercent.description: Annual shading loss in percent (0–100). Defaults to 0.

RoofPlaneRequest.description: One roof surface. Orientation (azimuth) and tilt are mandatory.

RoofType.description: Roof covering / construction; determines the mounting system.

validityDays.description: How long the quote is valid (1 to 365 days); defaults to `Quotes:DefaultValidityDays` (30).

ServiceTicketOrigin.description: Where a ticket came from (mapping #69). Story #122: the origin tells manual and automatic tickets apart.

ServiceTicketPriority.description: Priority of a ticket; the levels match the severity of an under-production event (ADR #194).

ServiceTicketState.description:
Lifecycle of a service ticket (mapping #69, BPMN #67 and #68). Story #121 names five states (Nový, Pridelený,
V riešení, Vyriešený, Uzavretý); the mapping document is the source of truth and splits them along the BPMN tasks.

roles.description: Role names (case-insensitive), at least one. Roles missing from the list are removed.

SetUserRolesRequest.description: Payload for `PUT /api/users/{id}/roles`: the complete set of roles the user should have.

ScheduleInstallationRequest.description: Planned mounting window of an installation.

supplyPointId.description: Supply point (odberné miesto) of the installation that the signature starts.

signedOn.description: Date of the signature; defaults to today (UTC) and must not be in the future.

installationName.description: Name of the created installation; defaults to "Inštalácia" plus the contract number.

StringLayoutResponse.description: Whole layout of an installation: strings ordered by number and installed panels not yet assigned to any string.

StringPanelResponse.description: A panel placed in a string.

SupplyPointResponse.description: Supply point returned by the API.

SystemInfoResponse.description: Basic information about the running API.

TechnicianResponse.description: User with role Technician that a planner can assign (#89).

sentAt.description: When the batch was sent, ISO 8601 UTC (suffix Z).

TelemetryBatchRequest.description:
Ingest batch of inverter measurements (contract of ADR #185, `schemaVersion` 1.0).
Status, source and timestamps are strings on purpose: an invalid value then yields a 400 that names the field
instead of a bare deserialization error. Validation of the nested readings is done here because the
DataAnnotations filter does not descend into collections; error keys look like `readings[3].timestamp`.

TelemetryIngestResponse.description: Result of an ingest: how many readings were new and how many were duplicates (ignored).

timestamp.description: End of the averaging window, UTC, 5-minute grid (minutes divisible by 5, seconds 0).

intervalSec.description: Length of the averaging window in seconds (1 to 3600), 300 by default.

status.description: SunSpec state: OFF, SLEEPING, STARTING, MPPT, THROTTLED, SHUTTING_DOWN, FAULT, STANDBY.

events.description: Active event names, e.g. GROUND_FAULT (A-Z, 0-9, underscore; unique).

totalEnergyWh.description: Lifetime produced energy in Wh, monotonic counter.

dayEnergyWh.description: Optional device-reported energy since local midnight; informative only.

TelemetryReadingRequest.description: One measurement of an inverter (`deviceId` is the id of an inverter registered in the installation).

TelemetryStringRequest.description: Values of one DC input (MPPT / string), SunSpec model 160.

contentBase64.description: Base64 content; at most long ServiceTicket.MaxAttachmentBytes before encoding.

TicketAttachmentRequest.description: A photo or document sent with a new ticket as base64.

TicketAttachmentResponse.description: Attachment metadata; the content is downloaded from string TicketAttachmentResponse.DownloadUrl.

TicketConfirmationDecision.description: Decision of the customer after the ticket was closed (story #129).

TicketListItem.description: One row of the ticket list.

TicketResponse.description: Ticket detail returned by the API.

TicketStateChangeResponse.description: History entry. string? TicketStateChangeResponse.Note is null for customers (internal note).

TicketStateResponse.description: State of a ticket after verify or close.

TicketVisitsResponse.description: Visits of one ticket and its assigned technician (null for customers).

refreshToken.description: Opaque refresh token; keep it out of persistent storage.

TokenResponse.description:
Tokens returned after login (and refresh). The access token is a JWT for the `Authorization: Bearer` header;
the refresh token is opaque, single-use and valid for 7 days.

oneOf.description: Target state; `VisitScheduled`, `OnSite` and `Verified` are reserved for visits (#36, #37).

note.description: Internal note stored in the history; not shown to the customer.

TriageTicketRequest.description: Payload of `PUT /api/tickets/{id}/triage`: decide the priority of a new ticket.

UnderproductionAlarmListResponse.description: Underproduction alarms of an installation, newest first, at most 100.

id.description: Stable for the same installation and start.

start.description: End of the first underproducing hour, UTC.

end.description: End of the event; null while it is ongoing.

detectedAt.description: End of the hour that confirmed the event.

lastUnderproductionAt.description: End of the last underproducing hour.

severity.description: Severity by the ratio and duration.

ticketPriority.description: Priority of the service ticket: by the detection, raised by a large loss.

medianRatio.description: Median of actual / expected power in the event.

minRatio.description: Lowest actual / expected power in the event.

updatedAt.description: Last time an analysis reported this alarm.

ticketId.description: Service ticket handling the alarm; null when it has none (an ended event gets none).

UnderproductionAlarmResponse.description: Underproduction event (ADR #194). Hours are labelled by their end, as the detection reports them.

powerW.description: Rated power in watts; required for panels and inverters.

unitPrice.description: Price per unit in EUR (per hour for labor), at most two decimals.

UpdateConnectionRequestRequest.description: Payload for updating a draft connection request; the installation stays the same.

email.description: Contact e-mail; must be unique among customers.

userId.description: Optional login account (user with role Customer) linked to this customer.

UpdateCustomerRequest.description: Payload for `PUT /api/customers/{id}` (full replacement of the editable data).

annualConsumptionKwh.description: Annual electricity consumption of the supply point in kWh.

UpdateDesignParametersRequest.description: Roof, consumption and location inputs of the design.

UpdateChecklistStepRequest.description: Marks a checklist step done or not done (#90).

UpdateInstallationRequest.description: Payload for updating descriptive fields of an installation.

number.description: String number as the inverter reports it in telemetry (`strings[].id`); unique within the installation.

mpptInput.description: MPPT input of the inverter the string is wired to.

eicCode.description: EIC code of the metering point (16 characters, e.g. "24ZSS1234567890A"); whitespace is ignored.

mainBreakerAmps.description: Rated current of the main circuit breaker in amperes (1-1000).

UserRolesResponse.description: User with the roles currently assigned.

VisitCause.description: Cause found on site; the code list of the service protocol (story #127). NoFaultFound feeds the false-alarm statistics (#129).

oneOf.description: The new device; validated exactly like `POST /api/installations/{id}/devices/{deviceId}/replace`.

VisitDeviceReplacementRequest.description: Payload of `POST /api/visits/{id}/device-replacements`: a device of the ticket's installation replaced during the visit.

VisitDeviceReplacementResult.description: Result of recording a used-material list.

VisitReportResponse.description: Service protocol of a visit; string? VisitReportResponse.Findings is internal and null for customers.
